title.zh: 从国会救济基金中向南伊洛克斯省提供 20000 比索、向朗布隆省提供 8000 比索、向阿布拉省提供 6000 比索（均为菲律宾货币）贷款，用于上述各省建设中等教育公立学校的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A LOAN OF TWENTY THOUSAND PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, TO THE PROVINCE OF ILOCOS SUR, EIGHT THOUSAND PESOS TO THE PROVINCE OF ROMBLON, AND SIX THOUSAND PESOS TO THE PROVINCE OF ABRA, FROM THE CONGRESSIONAL RELIEF FUND, FOR USE IN THE CONSTRUCTION IN SAID PROVINCES OF PUBLIC SCHOOLS OF SECONDARY INSTRUCTION.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A LOAN OF TWENTY THOUSAND PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, TO THE PROVINCE OF ILOCOS SUR, EIGHT THOUSAND PESOS TO THE PROVINCE OF ROMBLON, AND SIX THOUSAND PESOS TO THE PROVINCE OF ABRA, FROM THE CONGRESSIONAL RELIEF FUND, FOR USE IN THE CONSTRUCTION IN SAID PROVINCES OF PUBLIC SCHOOLS OF SECONDARY INSTRUCTION.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp khoản vay 20.000 peso Philippines cho tỉnh Ilocos Sur, 8.000 peso Philippines cho tỉnh Romblon và 6.000 peso Philippines cho tỉnh Abra từ Quỹ Cứu trợ Quốc hội để xây dựng trường trung học công lập tại các tỉnh này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดให้มีการกู้ยืมยี่สิบพันเปโซฟิลิปปินส์สำหรับจังหวัดอิโลโกสซูร์ แปดพันเปโซฟิลิปปินส์สำหรับจังหวัดรอมบลอน และหกพันเปโซฟิลิปปินส์สำหรับจังหวัดอับรากองทุนบรรเทาทุกข์ของรัฐสภาเพื่อใช้ในการก่อสร้างโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาของรัฐในจังหวัดที่กล่าวมา
title.id: Undang-Undang menyediakan pinjaman 20.000 peso Filipina untuk Provinsi Ilocos Sur, 8.000 peso Filipina untuk Provinsi Romblon, dan 6.000 peso Filipina untuk Provinsi Abra dari Dana Bantuan Kongres guna pembangunan sekolah menengah negeri di provinsi-provinsi tersebut
title.ms: Akta menyediakan pinjaman dua puluh ribu peso Filipina kepada Wilayah Ilocos Sur, lapan ribu peso Filipina kepada Wilayah Romblon, dan enam ribu peso Filipina kepada Wilayah Abra daripada Dana Bantuan Kongres untuk pembinaan sekolah menengah awam di wilayah-wilayah tersebut

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, from any funds of the Congressional relief fund not otherwise
appropriated, the following sums in Philippine currency, to be loaned to the provinces hereinafter designated,
for expenditure under the direction of the respective provincial boards, in the construction of the necessary
building or buildings for a secondary school of public instruction in such locality in each of the said
provinces as may be selected by the provincial board and approved by the General Superintendent of
Education, and for no other purpose:
a. To the Province of Ilocos Sur, twenty thousand pesos to he repaid to the Insular Treasury as
follows: Five thousand pesos Philippine currency, within one year from the date of the
acceptance of the loan, and five thousand pesos each year thereafter until the full amount of the
loan has been satisfied.
b. To the Province of Bomblon, eight thousand pesos, to be repaid to the insular Treasury as
follows: Two thousand pesos within one year from the date of the acceptance of the loan, and
three thousand pesos each year thereafter until the full amount of the loan has been satisfied.
c. To the Province of Abra, six thousand pesos, to be repaid the Insular Treasury as follows:
One thousand two hundred pesos within one year from the date of the acceptance of the loan,
and one thousand two hundred pesos each year thereafter until the full amount of the loan has
been satisfied.
